title: An analogue of irreducible cuspidal representations for the group $PGL(2)$ over a two-dimensional local field
summary: Let $F$ be a local non-archimedian field of odd residue characteristic and let $G=PGL(2)$. In this paper we study an analog of irreducible cuspidal representations of the group $G(F)$ when $F$ is replaced by the field $K=F((t))$. The story turns out to be similar to the classical case, but also with some differences. We present a construction of such representations essentially (up to a small subtlety) starting from a quadratic extension $L$ of $K$ and a character $θ:L^*/K^*\to \mathbb C^*$ which is not Galois invariant.
